request: The static site only has a home page and an about page, so there is nowhere to send visitors who want directions or opening hours. Add a new page at the /contact/ route that uses the shared layout, shows a heading and a short paragraph, and links back home like the other pages do. Make sure the site still builds and the new route loads.

plan.goal: Give the site a contact page the header can reach, so visitors have somewhere to find directions and opening hours.

scope.title: A /contact/ page
scope.description: Add src/pages/contact.astro that imports BaseLayout, renders an h1 heading and a short paragraph, and links back to the home page. The file path becomes the /contact/ route.

steps.description: Create src/pages/contact.astro importing ../layouts/BaseLayout.astro and set its title prop to "Contact".
Render an h1 heading, a short paragraph of directions, and a link back to /.
Run the build so dist/contact/index.html is emitted; the build fails if the new page's frontmatter or imports are wrong.

out_of_scope.item: Adding a header nav entry pointing at the new page
out_of_scope.reason: The nav list lives in the shared layout; changing what the header shows on every page is a separate layout change, not part of adding one page.

out_of_scope.item: Moving the contact form from the home page onto the new page
out_of_scope.reason: Relocating existing content would change the home page the starter's tests already cover, which is beyond adding a page.
